description: Config-driven browser flow descriptor for China Unicom Cloud Drive desktop web login, personal-space upload, directory creation, deletion, rename, copy, and move.
notes: This file records selectors, JS entrypoints, and expected network requests without storing live credentials.
Placeholders such as {{inputs.sms_code}} and {{runtime.access_token}} are symbolic and must be resolved at runtime by the browser automation layer.
When pan.wo.cn changes its DOM, update this file first before changing Rust provider logic.

operations.source: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('input.el-checkbox__original[type="checkbox"]') || document.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]'); const label = document.querySelector('label.el-checkbox'); const alreadyChecked = !!input?.checked || !!label?.classList?.contains('is-checked') || !!document.querySelector('.el-checkbox__input.is-checked'); if (alreadyChecked) { return { changed: false, checked: true }; } if (label) { label.click(); } else if (input) { input.checked = true; for (const eventName of ['input', 'change', 'click']) { input.dispatchEvent(new Event(eventName, { bubbles: true })); } } const checked = !!input?.checked || !!label?.classList?.contains('is-checked') || !!document.querySelector('.el-checkbox__input.is-checked'); if (!checked) { throw new Error('agreement checkbox did not become checked'); } return { changed: true, checked: true }; })()
notes: This operation is idempotent: if the agreement is already checked, it leaves the page unchanged.
Use this instead of a blind checkbox click so resume flows do not accidentally toggle the agreement back off.

operations.source: (() => { const KEY = '__ccbgUnicomSendCodeFeedback'; const SELECTORS = ['.el-message__content', '.el-message', '.el-notification__content', '.el-message-box__message', '.el-form-item__error', '[role="alert"]', '[role="status"]', '.toast', '.toast-message', '.toast-text', '.notice', '.alert']; const normalize = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const isVisible = (node) => { if (!(node instanceof Element)) { return false; } const rect = typeof node.getBoundingClientRect === 'function' ? node.getBoundingClientRect() : { width: 0, height: 0 }; if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) { return false; } const style = typeof window.getComputedStyle === 'function' ? window.getComputedStyle(node) : null; return !style || (style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.opacity !== '0'); }; const looksRelevant = (text, node) => { if (!text || text.length > 80) { return false; } if (/[\r\n]/.test(text) && text.length > 48) { return false; } if (/(验证码|短信|稍后|频繁|失败|异常|重新获取|发送)/.test(text)) { return true; } const cls = String(node?.className || '').toLowerCase(); const role = String(node?.getAttribute?.('role') || '').toLowerCase(); return /message|toast|notice|alert|error|warn|tip/.test(cls) || role === 'alert' || role === 'status'; }; const capture = (rawText, source) => { const text = normalize(rawText); const state = window[KEY]; if (!state || !looksRelevant(text, state.last_node || null)) { return false; } const now = Date.now(); const last = state.messages[state.messages.length - 1]; if (last && last.text === text && now - last.seen_at_unix_ms < 1200) { state.last_seen_at_unix_ms = now; return false; } const entry = { text, source, seen_at_unix_ms: now }; state.messages.push(entry); if (state.messages.length > 12) { state.messages = state.messages.slice(-12); } state.last_message = text; state.last_source = source; state.last_seen_at_unix_ms = now; return true; }; const inspectNode = (node, source) => { if (!(node instanceof Element) || !isVisible(node)) { return false; } const text = normalize(node.innerText || node.textContent || ''); const state = window[KEY]; if (state) { state.last_node = node; } return capture(text, source); }; const scan = (root, source) => { const scope = root instanceof Element || root instanceof Document ? root : document; for (const selector of SELECTORS) { const nodes = scope.querySelectorAll ? Array.from(scope.querySelectorAll(selector)) : []; for (const node of nodes) { inspectNode(node, `${source}:${selector}`); } } }; const previous = window[KEY]; if (previous?.observer && typeof previous.observer.disconnect === 'function') { previous.observer.disconnect(); } if (previous?.poller) { window.clearInterval(previous.poller); } const state = { installed_at_unix_ms: Date.now(), messages: [], last_message: '', last_source: '', last_seen_at_unix_ms: 0, observer: null, poller: null, last_node: null }; window[KEY] = state; if (!document.body) { return { installed: false, reason: 'document.body missing' }; } scan(document, 'install'); const observer = new MutationObserver((records) => { for (const record of records) { if (record.target instanceof Element) { inspectNode(record.target, 'mutation-target'); } for (const node of Array.from(record.addedNodes || [])) { if (node instanceof Element) { inspectNode(node, 'mutation-added'); scan(node, 'mutation-scan'); } } } }); observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true }); state.observer = observer; state.poller = window.setInterval(() => { const liveState = window[KEY]; if (!liveState) { return; } if (Date.now() - liveState.installed_at_unix_ms > 15000) { if (liveState.observer && typeof liveState.observer.disconnect === 'function') { liveState.observer.disconnect(); } if (liveState.poller) { window.clearInterval(liveState.poller); liveState.poller = null; } return; } scan(document, 'poll'); }, 250); return { installed: true, selector_count: SELECTORS.length }; })()
notes: Install a short-lived DOM observer before clicking the SMS send-code control so transient toast/error feedback can be captured into window.__ccbgUnicomSendCodeFeedback.
This helps the assistant detect cases like rate limiting even when the page only flashes the message briefly.

root.querySelectorAll('img, canvas') : []); const match = candidates.find(el => { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width < 20 || rect.height < 12) { return false; } const haystack = [el.getAttribute('src') || '', el.getAttribute('alt') || '', el.getAttribute('class') || '', el.parentElement?.className || ''].join(' ').toLowerCase(); return /captcha|verify|check|code|yzm|identify/.test(haystack) || candidates.length === 1; }); if (match) { captchaImage = match; break; } } const sendButton = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.change-code')).find(el => { const text = normalize(el.innerText || ''); return isVisible(el) && (text === '发送验证码' || text === '重新发送' || /\d+\s*(s|S|秒)/.test(text)); }); const captchaChallengeVisible = !!captchaInput && isVisible(captchaInput) && !!captchaImage && isVisible(captchaImage); const captchaValue = normalize(captchaInput?.value || ''); if (!captchaChallengeVisible) { return { clicked: false, reason: 'captcha_not_present' }; } if (!captchaValue) { return { clicked: false, reason: 'captcha_value_missing' }; } if (!sendButton) { throw new Error('send code button not available for captcha retry'); } sendButton.click(); return { clicked: true, reason: 'captcha_present', captcha_length: captchaValue.length }; })()

flows.purpose: Copy a visible file or directory into another visible directory by driving the file-list selection state and action-dialog submit path.

inputs.label: Entry Name
inputs.description: Visible file or directory name in the current list context.

inputs.label: Target Directory Name
inputs.description: Visible directory name in the current list context that should receive the copied entry.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 with temporary probe directories in personal root.
The live page also queried QueryDirectorys and QueryFamilyGroups around the copy dialog, but CopyFile plus the root list refresh are the core write-path signals.

flows.title: Unicom Move Entry
flows.purpose: Move a visible file or directory into another visible directory by driving the file-list selection state and action-dialog submit path.

inputs.label: Entry Name
inputs.description: Visible file or directory name in the current list context.

inputs.label: Target Directory Name
inputs.description: Visible directory name in the current list context that should receive the moved entry.

notes: Validated on 2026-05-12 with temporary probe directories in personal root.
The live page issues a QueryDirectorys preflight before MoveFile, so the operation intentionally waits for the dialog state to settle before submit.
